title.narrative: Strengthening education coordination to the education sector in Iraq

description.narrative: The Education Sector Coordination Group (ESCG) was created by Iraq’s Ministry of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, and partners to improve coordination and alignment of education support with the Iraq National Education Strategy (INES). Replacing the humanitarian-focused cluster system, ESCG promotes inclusive dialogue among government, donors, and partners. Supported by UNESCO, it ensures effective use of resources, monitors sector performance, conducts reviews, and strengthens capacity. Guided by global aid effectiveness principles, ESCG aims to enhance impact, reduce duplication, and support sustainable development of Iraq’s education sector.
